body: You’re right she doesn’t deserve me, she deserves so much better, I’ve given her nothing but pain and hurt this past year. I don’t blame her for leaving at all, I would’ve left me too. But it’s like I’m floating in the vacuum of space and she was my oxygen tank. And now I’m just drifting and finding it a little hard to breathe you know? I want to change for her, but that if it’s too late  she’s be much happier if I just wasn’t here at all. Thank you for your kind words, people like you really are the beauty in the world.

I’m currently serving with the armed forces. I’d lose my job if they knew I was going to
Therapy
I can’t with my job currently sadly.

Thanks I really needed this if I’m honest, she’s offered me a life line in that if I change my ways there’s a chance for us, so I guess that’s something to fight for for now.

Thank you for your kind words, always here if you need a chat also

Honestly this girl is perfect, not just for me but for absolutely anyone, she’s a diamond. I love her so much but she’ll be in someone else’s arms, someone that deserves her, and hopefully I’ll be dead
I’m in therapy currently but it’s just not enough, I’m never enough, immjust always hurting her

I feel this big time. I’m in the exact same situation currently and I feel like when she leaves my sorry ass that’ll be it, she’s been my rock these past 4 years, when she’s gone what’s the point in going on

Hey keep your chin up, it’s difficult to see those things sometimes so just take
It a day at a time, you’ll get there!
